bootstrap_scope: Within-checkpoint slot-clustered percentile intervals for predeclared contrasts; exploratory, unadjusted for multiplicity. Training-seed spread is reported separately, not pooled into bit-level tests.

source_boundaries.nonlinear_restore: Exact RMS, reciprocal division and torch.tanh together; retain W8A8 elsewhere.
source_boundaries.mixed_precision_probes: W8A16 and W16A8 reinterpret the fixed QAT checkpoint/frozen maxima without retraining or recalibration.
source_boundaries.float_qat_counterfactual: Disable quantization and nonlinear approximations while retaining learned QAT weights and learned delta.
source_boundaries.matrix_fft: Fixed W8A8 checkpoint, same calibration and traffic; transform backend only is changed.
source_boundaries.training_seeds_vs_slots: Three trained seeds are replication; slots quantify conditional simulation uncertainty only.
